text: If you're looking to start selling on Amazon, this is the best first video to start with. My name is Travis and I've done over $7 million in sales on Amazon, and I'm going to show you step by step how to sell on Amazon. So, make sure to smash the like button because the first step is to go to sell.amazon.com and sign up for a seller account. You're going to choose the professional plan, which costs $39.99 a month, but it's worth it if you're serious and you're looking to make real money with Amazon. Step two is to find a product to sell on Amazon. And Amazon is a search engine. So, the key is selling a product that people are searching for. And you can use tools like Helium 10. I have a link down below that will get you a free account as well as a discount if you want to upgrade to a premium membership. And using this, you can find huge opportunities. I use this to find a product that's making me 60 to $100,000 per month on Amazon. Step three is to find a manufacturer and you can use Alibaba.com to find manufacturers overseas or ThomasNet or Google if you want to find US suppliers. Step four is to create your listing on Amazon, which you can do by logging into your Seller Central account, clicking on add a new product. Then you're going to put in the title, the main image. You're going to upload all the other images of your product as well as what you want the bullet points and the description for your product to be. And then boom, step five, it's time for you to launch your product. And the goal is to get as many sales as possible from day one, which will make it so that your product shows up higher in the Amazon search results. And the higher your product is in the Amazon search results, the more sales you're going to get. So, this is going to snowball into more and more sales until you're making legitimate passive income from your Amazon business. And if you want my help creating your own Amazon FBA business, next week I'm opening up 50 spots for my Amazon FBA full training program. There's a link down below to sign up for the weight list and get more information about that. However, in the meantime, I have a completely free 12-hour Amazon FBA course that you can get just by clicking right here. But there is going to be a lot more information in my full complete training program that I'm opening up next week. And again, you can sign up for the weight list for that down below. So, click to sign up for the weight list and hopefully I will see you in the program. Thanks for watching.
